title: Lekythos with Seated and Standing Figures
acquisition: Inscription metadata from official Walters art.csv export. Image from Walters donation to Wikimedia Commons. Longer artwork descriptions excluded.
original_inscription_field: [Inscription; over the figures] ΑΔΑ ΜΙΚΩΝ ΕΞ ΣΙΓΕΙΟΥ [Transliteration] Ἄδα. Μίκων ἐξ Σιγείου [Translation] Ada. Mikon from Sigeion
geography: Greek funerary vessel; Sigeion is in the personal label, not assumed to be its findspot.
provenance: Roussos, Athens, [date and mode of acquisition unknown]; Joseph Brummer, Paris and New York,  1924, by purchase [Brummer inv. no. P1502]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1925 [mode of acquisition unknown]; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
coverage_evidence: Both figure labels are included: Ada and Mikon with his place-name. Museum identifies no longer inscription.
visual_observation: Black-and-white photograph of surviving marble funerary vessel. Labels above figures are faint; weathered surface, central crack and missing neck/base. Source supplies reading, not independently verified from photo.
rights_scope: Inscription metadata CC0 under current museum policy; photograph reused under explicit Commons file-page CC BY-SA 3.0 terms. Longer GFDL descriptions excluded.

image_rights_evidence.creator: The Walters Art Museum
image_rights_evidence.scope: File page distinguishes the public-domain ancient object from its photograph. Photograph section explicitly offers CC BY-SA 3.0 and GFDL; CC BY-SA 3.0 selected.
